data.text: Invulnerability of the chosen element until end of round (playable as a counter action).

logic.description: Implemented instant counter. On completion the caster is invulnerable for the rest of the turn to one element — the element that would hurt it most this round (threatElem), else the cast element; a shielded element contributes 0 to Rule 21 / point-buy sums against the holder. ∀ double cast: the shield becomes a permanent in front of the deck (shieldElems permanent) instead of lapsing at turn end. Rule 8 pc override: a Shield that saved nothing returns to hand.

prerequisites.description: An instant rides on any action (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Elements the holder is immune to this turn.
Whether the shield outlives the turn as a permanent (1 on a ∀ double cast, else 0).

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_concentration (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
The ∀ double-cast bonus text stays present (the engine unlocks it on a Rule 23 chained cast).
